description: Make a change in a monorepo or multi-module workspace (pnpm, npm, or yarn workspaces, Turborepo, Nx, Go workspaces with go.work, uv workspaces, or Cargo workspaces) by finding the package that owns the code and the packages that depend on it, keeping package boundaries, updating internal dependency versions and the lockfile with the workspace tool, and building and testing only what is affected, then the whole workspace when shared code changed. Use when a change touches code shared by several packages, modules, or services in a workspace, or when the user asks to change, fix, or add behavior in such a repository. Do not use for adding or extracting a whole package (use kit-monorepo-package), for release versioning (use kit-monorepo-release), for reviewing boundaries without changes (use kit-monorepo-review), or for single-package repositories.
